findings.evidence: A genuine drag-gesture widget test for ReorderableListView was attempted and found unreliable in this test environment, matching a documented limitation this codebase's own history already noted for an equivalent (now-deleted) feature. The widget test covers rendering/Semantics instead; the identity-vs-position payload correctness that actually matters is covered by direct reorder() cubit tests, which exercise the same production code path onReorderItem would call.
findings.why_it_matters: Not a defect — the coverage gap is disclosed transparently in the phase file rather than silently omitted, and the higher-risk logic (payload shape) has real coverage via the cubit tests.
findings.required_action: None — accept as documented; a future Flutter SDK/testing-library improvement to ReorderableListView drag simulation could close this fully, not required for this plan.
